releases.notes:
# Changelog V1.2.1

## Added

- Added two advancements: Firewall for winning Ransomware and STOP Right There for banishing Ransom with a Crucifix.

- Fully Hijacked players can no longer send chat messages or private messages. Trying to speak displays `YOU CAN'T SPEAK`.

## Fixed

- Flying Hijacked Creeper heads are now immune to damage and no longer stop when hit.

- Fixed a crash with Origins/Apoli when Ransomware starts.

- Fixed Underground Ransom deleting items when item deletion is disabled.

- Fixed Toggle Sprint and Toggle Sneak incorrectly triggering Ransom during STOP after releasing the key. Held-input checks now use the physical controls, including custom keyboard and mouse bindings.

- Improved compatibility with mods that change entity rendering when banishing Hijacked mobs.
- Fixed automatic waking from a bed during STOP incorrectly triggering Ransomware.

releases.notes:
# Changelog V1.2

## Added

### Crucifix

- Added a Crucifix with **100 durability** and Moonlight banishment effects.
- Keep it in your inventory to banish Ransom when he attacks, or use it on another player to free them from Ransomware. Uses **10 durability**.
- Use it on a corrupted chest to banish Stealer and save the remaining loot. Uses **5 durability**.
- Hit a Hijacked mob with it to banish the mob in a blue flash. Uses **1 durability**.
- Craft it with **four stripped logs, one diamond, and two gold blocks**. The recipe appears in your recipe book after your first Ransomware or Stealer encounter.

### Hijack Level 5

- At **100 Hijack**, Ransom takes control of your body. Your character can move and attack while you play a minigame to regain control.
- Keep your marker inside the moving area and click in time with the ring for bonus progress. Completing the minigame lowers Hijack to **50**.
- At **30% progress**, your inventory becomes available. Right-click a Honey Pot in your inventory to use it and free yourself.

### Honey Pot

- Added the Honey Pot, which clears Hijack and grants **10 minutes of Firewall protection** against further Hijack buildup.
- Right-click the Honey Pot in your inventory to use it.
- Craft it with **one decorated pot and one honey block**. Plain and patterned pots both work.

### Underground Ransom

- At **Y ≤ 62** in the Overworld, a new encounter replaces Ransomware. Moonlight pushes Ransom out of your body, and he attacks as a cloud of glitches.
- Hit Ransom to knock him away. Watch for changes in direction and teleports; the attacked player can see and hit him through walls.
- The encounter lasts **eight attacks**, whether you parry them or get hit.
- Each hit you fail to parry deals **2 HP**, adds **10 Hijack**, and takes an entire random stack from your hotbar. If your hotbar is empty, Ransom takes a stack from your main inventory instead.

## Balance

- Damaging a Hijacked creeper now makes it display a STOP sign and freeze for **5 seconds**. Further hits restart the pause.
- Honey bottles now reduce Hijack by **15**, unless you are fully Hijacked.

## Fixed

- Fixed displaced and oversized glitch overlays on Hijacked mobs and the false Hijacked appearances at Hijack level 3.
- Spectators no longer trigger Ransom: Stealer when opening loot chests.

## Configuration

### Ransom: Stealer difficulty

- Added **Easy**, **Normal**, and **Hard**. Normal keeps the original timing and is the default.
- Easy gives you **0.4 extra seconds for the first key** and **0.1 extra seconds for each of the next two**.
- Hard gives you **0.1 fewer seconds for each of the first three keys**.
